name: Disenchantment
description: Set in a ruined medieval city called Dreamland, Disenchantment follows the grubby adventures of a hard-drinking princess, her feisty elf companion and her personal demon.

videos.title: A Princess, an Elf, and a Demon Walk Into a Bar
videos.overview: Princess Bean already has the wedding day blues when a mysterious figure arrives, claiming he's her personal demon. Elfo hates his happy homeland.

videos.title: For Whom the Pig Oinks
videos.overview: How to get rid of an unwanted fiancé? Bean's plan involves a party barge and mermaids. King Zøg tries to make Elfo's blood into an immortality potion.

videos.title: The Princess of Darkness
videos.overview: Sorcerio declares that demonic possession is behind Bean's drunken exploits -- and things look dicey for Luci when the king hires an eerie exorcist.

videos.title: Castle Party Massacre
videos.overview: With the king away, Bean throws a wild party while Odval and Sorcerio gather their secret society for a ritual. But the night takes a surprising turn.

videos.title: Faster, Princess! Kill! Kill!
videos.overview: Banished from the castle by Zøg, Bean tries to work but has trouble keeping a job. Elfo encounters a bizarre pair of siblings living in a candy house.

videos.title: Swamp and Circumstance
videos.overview: Bean tries her hand at diplomacy after Zøg makes her ambassador to Dankmire, Oona's kingdom and an important ally for Dreamland.

videos.title: Love's Tender Rampage
videos.overview: Elfo lies to hide his feelings for Bean, but things get complicated when she tries to help him by sending the knights on a quest.

videos.title: The Limits of Immortality
videos.overview: Elfo's been kidnapped! Bean, Luci, Sorcerio and the knights search for him, along with a magical pendant needed to complete the immortality potion.

videos.title: To Thine Own Elf Be True
videos.overview: After he learns a surprising secret about himself, Elfo heads home to Elfwood in search of the truth.

videos.title: Dreamland Falls
videos.overview: As Dreamland celebrates an unexpected arrival while saying goodbye to a friend, everyday life is thrown into disarray.

videos.title: The Disenchantress
videos.overview: Bean travels with Dagmar to her homeland, Maru, where she rescues an old friend and learns of a mysterious prophecy she's expected to fulfill.

videos.title: Stairway to Hell
videos.overview: Bean and Luci concoct a plan to resurrect Elfo. But he'll have to meet them in hell -- if he can get there. Zøg discovers a friend in frozen Dreamland.

videos.title: The Very Thing
videos.overview: Bean and her friends return to Dreamland but don't receive a warm welcome from Zøg. Oona inspires a lackluster band of pirates who rescue her at sea.

videos.title: The Lonely Heart Is a Hunter
videos.overview: Bean dreams about her mother and finds mystical Maruvian symbols around the castle. Zøg falls for an unusual woman he meets in the Enchanted Forest.

videos.title: Our Bodies, Our Elves
videos.overview: With a health crisis in Elf Alley, Bean and Elfo make a dangerous journey to find an ancient cure while Luci scams sick elves at his new clinic.

videos.title: The Dreamland Job
videos.overview: Learning that the elves are starving because of Zøg's excessive taxes, Bean plans a heist with a passing band of circus performers to recover the money.

videos.title: Love's Slimy Embrace
videos.overview: Despondent because Bean dislikes him and his mother's away, Derek makes friends with a slimy sea creature. Zøg tries to contract a rich man's disease.

videos.title: In Her Own Write
videos.overview: While Zøg refuses to face his feelings about Dagmar's betrayal, Bean writes to deal with her pain. But she faces obstacles to sharing her work.

videos.title: The Electric Princess
videos.overview: When a scientific man appears in Dreamland, he's regarded with suspicion. But Bean helps him escape and travels with him to a wondrous steampunk city.

videos.title: Tiabeanie Falls
videos.overview: With King Zøg incapacitated, Odval makes a power play, assisted by the Arch Druidess. Luci and Elfo try to help Bean.

videos.title: Subterranean Homesick Blues
videos.overview: Bean, Elfo and Luci become trapped in an underground world full of eerie little creatures — and Queen Dagmar. Zøg tries to thwart a plot against him.

videos.title: You're the Bean
videos.overview: As Zøg attempts to escape a harrowing situation, Derek discovers a book that implies his family is cursed. Bean hatches a plan to escape from Trøgtown.

videos.title: Beanie Get Your Gun
videos.overview: Zøg's acting strange, and Bean investigates to learn why. Meanwhile, a despondent Derek finds some surprising mentors in the Enchanted Forest.

videos.title: Steamland Confidential
videos.overview: After traveling to Steamland, Elfo enthralls the denizens of an upscale explorers' club while Bean infiltrates a factory in search of the Arch Druidess.

videos.title: Freak Out!
videos.overview: Bean flees when she discovers more about Alva's intentions — and as his lightbulb-headed robots chase her through Steamland, she searches for Elfo.

videos.title: Last Splash
videos.overview: On their return trip to Dreamland via steamboat, lovelorn Elfo winds up in an unusual relationship while Bean gets close to Mora the mermaid.

videos.title: Bad Moon Rising
videos.overview: Bean overhears Odval and the council plotting against Zøg, so she joins forces with Oona to undermine their plan while Elfo and Luci raise an army.

videos.title: Hey, Pig Spender
videos.overview: After trying to help Prince Merkimer lift the curse that turned him into a pig, Bean asks his parents for resources to thwart the threat from Steamland.

videos.title: The Madness of King Zøg
videos.overview: As a mysterious cloud of green smoke moves toward Dreamland and Zøg becomes more unstable than ever, Bean finds a unique way to communicate with him.

videos.title: Bean Falls Down
videos.overview: Bean's having a stressful day! First, an old nemesis arrives, acting suspiciously contrite. Then, vicious ogres invade and won't leave without Elfo.

videos.title: Love Is Hell
videos.overview: In hell, Bean resists Dagmar's attempts to force her to marry Satan. Meanwhile, Luci plots to flee heaven and Elfo tries to escape from the ogres.

videos.title: The Good, The Bad, and the Bum-Bum
videos.overview: Bean, Jerry and Luci commandeer an airship from Alva. Held captive by the ogres, Elfo discovers an entire family history he knew nothing about.

videos.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Chazzzzz
videos.overview: Zøg is institutionalized with Chazzzzz, while Vip and Vap launch an epic rescue. Bean doesn't get the warm reception she expects at Dreamland.

videos.title: Goon Baby Goon
videos.overview: Bean and her friends are reunited with Zøg and discover that Becky and Cloyd have seized Dreamland, secretly transforming its citizens into goons.

videos.title: The Pitter-Patter of Little Feet
videos.overview: After Sorcerio brings Freckles to life, the wooden puppet sets out to undermine Zøg with a comedy roast and an alliance with Becky and Cloyd

videos.title: What to Expect When You're Expecting Parasites
videos.overview: Zøg, Bean and her friends plunge into the ocean, where they find a submerged castle inhabited by Sea Trøgs guarding a treasure linked to the Elves.

videos.title: The Unbearable Lightning of Bean
videos.overview: Lonely Zøg searches the forest for his true love, Ursula the Bear, who's got a secret. Elfo, Luci and Bean stumble upon the site of an ancient battle.

videos.title: Spy Vs. Spy Vs. Spy
videos.overview: Ordered to spy on the elves, Elfo is captured and forced to spy on the Trøgs - who see through his disguise and return him to spy on the humans.

videos.title: The Goo-Bye Girl
videos.overview: Freckles manipulates Derek and Bear Boy into confronting some bullies. The secret of the goo is out but who will drink it to become the savior?

videos.title: Bean Falls Apart
videos.overview: In her dreams, Bean confronts her inner "Bad Bean" but the evil doppelgänger conceals a sinister plot. Derek, Bear Boy and Freckles get captured.

videos.title: Heads or Tails
videos.overview: Queen Dagmar interrogates the Dreamland townsfolk to find out who's hiding Bean's body. Meanwhile, Luci reconnects with his estranged father.

videos.title: Fish Out of Water
videos.overview: While Bean and the crew try to find a place to dispose of the body, King Zøg battles cops, robots and an angry mob to rescue his three sons.

videos.title: Electric Ladyland
videos.overview: After Malfus foretells an ominous prophecy, Bean and Mora travel to Steamland to reconnect with Zøg — but first they must decode a cryptic message.

videos.title: I Hear Your Noggin, But You Can't Come In
videos.overview: Zøg, Bean and Mora search for a way into the Freak Show to free Derek, Bear Boy and Freckles. Then, Elfo and the crew elude a persistent Bad Bean.

videos.title: Who Shot Elfo?
videos.overview: Tormented by the mystery of his death, Elfo takes an ill-advised trip to figure out who shot him. Meanwhile, Luci hides Bad Bean's head from Satan.

videos.title: The Stience of Homemade Lightning
videos.overview: In the forgotten city of Maru, Bean meets the Queen of the Crones, who encourages her to harness her new special power. Later, Elfo falls for a friend.

videos.title: Gimme Gimme Shock Treatment
videos.overview: As the townsfolk prepare for war, Bean and Zøg land in the Twinkletown Asylum, where the princess makes a stunning realization about her destiny.

videos.title: The Battle of Falling Water
videos.overview: A battle between the Dreamland army and Dagmar's forces may spell disaster for Princess Bean, unless she can defeat her greatest foe: herself.

videos.title: Darkness Falls
videos.overview: With the Crystal Caverns magic flowing throughout the kingdom, only Bean can stop power from falling into the wrong hands — if she can quit moping first.

videos.title: Goodbye Bean
videos.overview: With the fate of Dreamland hanging in the balance, a mother battles her daughter for beauty, power and immortality. But living forever comes at a price.
